description:
The Nikke who plays Black in the hit show Ark Rangers.
While she already plays a hero on TV, her dream is to become a real hero off-screen. She is always pushing herself to the limit through an intense training regimen.

lines.text: Ark Ranger Black! Transform!
Once again, I've protected peace on the Ark.
If trouble comes your way, call for the Ark Rangers. No matter where we are, we'll hear your call and come to your aid.
A hero doesn't entrust their back to just anyone... but with you, I think I can.
I respect you a great deal. You've become the Ark's hero, despite being an ordinary human.
Keep your eyes on us from here on out.
There are citizens out there right now living in fear. Let me go help them.
Preparations are complete. Call on the Ark Rangers whenever you need us.
I see there is now one more place the Ark Rangers must protect.
Everyone here deserves to be called a hero.
I'm going to stop by the gym. I can't neglect my training.
The Ark Rangers will always protect peace on the Ark!
An Ark Ranger never stops improving.
Now I can protect even more people.
Thank you. I've grown stronger because of you.
I... really didn't see this coming. Thank you.
Thank you. I'll fight to bring the gift of peace to more people.
This was exactly what I needed. I don't know how you knew, but I'll put it to good use.
... It seems I've found a new hero of my own.
I can't make sense of this feeling. Respect? Admiration? Or perhaps... something else.
You always inspire me. I want to become someone who can do the same.
Are you in need of a hero?
You called?
Moving out.
Ark Ranger Black, ready for battle!
Bring it on, you Rapture fiends!
Get behind me, everyone!
Don't worry, we'll protect you.
The enemy is strong.
Don't worry. Just trust us.
Anyone hurt?
Here I go!
Ultimate attack! Ark Black Meteor!
Our time is now!
Hardly a challenge.
That one's down.
Who's next?
Argh...!
I'm fine!
Ugh...!
A hero... never falls...!
Have no fear, for we will never lose!
